avis.texte: Honestly, I primarily purchased this product because it contains Urea, which I really like, especially since I have fungal acne. So far, I haven't noticed any issues with it. While I can't say I've experienced any additional benefits yet, I will continue using it as long as I don't encounter any negative side effects.
I’ve tried several different brands of hyaluronic acid. Due to my sensitive skin, I do appreciate that CUROLOGY offers this! I would recommend if you’re using any CUROLOGY brand skincare.
I absolutely love this product! My face has been very smooth and blemish free, not sure if that was the intended outcome but it is! I will be buying another bottle.

avis.titre: Excellent Dropper System! Hydrates Skin! Leaves Skin So Touchable!
avis.texte: This arrives nicely boxed. Pop this out and recycle that box. I like the dropper system here since it allows you to keep this product clean until the very last drop! Nice! This is a "thinner" liquid that moves over skin so effortlessly. And, it absorbs so quickly! Skin is left feeling soft and natural. (So, your face will not stick to your pillow and your hair will not stick to your face. Love that!) This really hydrates and softens skin beautifully. It is perfect for these brutally cold months. Just put this on throughout the day and keep your skin super supple! Such a great product at a stunningly excellent price! So very impressed at the excellent quality here! Wow! Highly recommended!

avis.titre: Fragrance Free, Clean Ingredients In a Glass Bottle
avis.texte: I appreciate the clean ingredients and packaging of this bottle of hyaluronic from Curology. The bottle came packaged in a cardboard box with no additional plastic (yay!). The hyaluronic itself has a smooth and goes on with a glass dropper. It has a faint medicinal odor but no fragrance, which I'm very appreciative of since I am allergic and sensitive to fragrance. It makes no sense to me why people put allergens like fragrance in products that you put on your face! Nice hydration from a known brand.

I've seen ads and commercials for cureology and being that I'm not an overly feminine woman, like I buy face moisturizer from the dollar store so nobody is selling me a $15-$20+ bottle of anything for my face. Happy to stand wrong on this. Here's how it went... clean face, 3 drops, rub into face, face feels sticky moist and bright, skin continues to look plump and healthy. Very effective with just a few drops, good value for your money at the rate you will you usr these drops vs a cream.

This serum is absolutely amazing, hydrating and plumping what it feels like. Soaks up fairly quickly and leaves skin soft and smooth, plus works so nicely with my night cream, it’s definitely my goodnight sleep for my skin. I love that my skin agrees with it so much and definitely having this rested and hydrated glow in the morning! Great quality and definitely effective, love this!
